other_conditions: Only two children per family are eligible for the scheme
Beneficiary must have a bank account to receive the scholarship
The beneficiary must have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days in the year preceding the application

After admission to college/polytechnic or other professional courses, the scholarship holder must study for a minimum of one year in that course; if the student drops out in the first year, the received amount must be returned
benefits_summary: The scheme provides an annual scholarship ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹10,000 depending on class, gender and level of study.
documents_required: Original scanned copy of the beneficiary's surviving labor registration identity card
Original scanned copy of Aadhaar card of the beneficiary's sons/daughters
Original scanned copy of the Principal's admission certificate in the prescribed format
Original scanned copy of the mark sheet of the previous class passed
Original scanned copy of the bank passbook
